name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat — Scene and Web in real time through the bundled WebWallGL engine, Video played directly — with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable blur/scrim/border/opacity, custom typography and caret, and a liquid-glass makeover of the whole settings window. Prerequisites (update BOTH first): latest DeepSeek Harness desktop (>= 0.2.0-rc.1) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0.
